description:
These 6x6 terracotta octagon wall tiles are natural terracotta in an eight-sided shape, measuring 6 x 6 inches, made for kitchen walls and backsplashes.

## How they look
Octagon tiles leave a small square gap at each corner where four tiles meet. That gap is usually filled with a small square insert (often in a contrasting colour) to make the classic octagon-and-dot pattern. Natural clay octagon tiles keep the warm terracotta colour without a glaze, with slight shade variation from tile to tile. Ask whether matching inserts are available before you plan the wall.

## Where they work
- **Kitchen backsplashes**: octagon backsplash tiles behind a counter or sink, once sealed.
- **Feature walls** in a dining nook or open kitchen.
- **Traditional or farmhouse kitchens**, where octagon kitchen wall tiles suit wooden cabinets and brass fittings.

## Good to know
- Size: 6 x 6 inches (as listed)
- Material: natural terracotta
- Shape: octagon
- Category: kitchen wall terracotta tiles

Octagons take more setting time than squares because the corner inserts must line up. Seal the clay before grouting so grout does not stain it, and reseal as your fixer advises, especially near the hob. Clean with a mild, pH-neutral cleaner.

## See it before you order
Pak Clay shows its range at the Lahore head office on Walton Road (opposite Packages Mall Gate 2) and at G-04 Civic Center, Executive Block, Gulberg Greens, Islamabad, Monday to Saturday, 9 am to 9 pm. Ask for a [free sample on WhatsApp](https://wa.me/923004617715) to check the colour, then get a dated quote for your 6x6 terracotta octagon wall tiles. Compare the [6x6 inch hexagon tiles](/products/natural-terracotta-hexagon-6x6-inch-tiles) or browse the [terracotta kitchen range](/categories/kitchen-wall-tiles-terracotta).

faqs.q: What is the price of 6x6 terracotta octagon tiles in Pakistan?
faqs.a: Pak Clay does not publish a fixed rate online. The price depends on the quantity, the area to cover and delivery to your city, so send your measurements on WhatsApp (+92 300 4617715) for a dated written quote.

faqs.q: Do octagon tiles need small square inserts?
faqs.a: Usually yes. Octagons leave a small square gap where four corners meet, which is filled with an insert. Ask Pak Clay on WhatsApp which inserts suit this tile.

faqs.q: Octagon or hexagon terracotta tiles for a kitchen wall?
faqs.a: Hexagons fit together with no gaps and give a honeycomb look. Octagons give the classic octagon-and-dot pattern but take more setting time because of the inserts.

faqs.q: Can I see a sample before ordering?
faqs.a: Yes. Message Pak Clay on WhatsApp at +92 300 4617715 with "Terracotta Octagon 6x6 Kitchen" and your city, or visit the Lahore showroom on Walton Road or the Islamabad location at G-04 Civic Center, Gulberg Greens, Monday to Saturday, 9 am to 9 pm.
